purpose: Stable spatial data contract for the ATUNED body-map prototype. This does not change the shipped application schema.

coordinateSystem.zMeaning: depth coordinate; required only where a source supports depth
coordinateSystem.rule: Never infer a missing depth coordinate from a front-view projection.

fields.id: Stable identifier for the anatomical place, not the display label.
fields.x: Finite number from 0 to 100 in normalized figure coordinates.
fields.y: Finite number from 0 to 100 in normalized figure coordinates.
fields.z: Finite number from 0 to 100 when known, otherwise null or omitted.
fields.evidence: Evidence class; proposed positions must never be represented as measured.
fields.source: Non-empty source identifier or reference description.
fields.landmarkId: Optional stable reference landmark used for registration.
fields.uncertaintyCm: Optional non-negative uncertainty estimate in centimetres.

rules: Region identifiers are stable and independent of display labels.
A region's geometry must use the same normalized coordinate space as positions.
A selected region may contain zero or more place identifiers; membership is explicit, not inferred from seat bands.

grid.rule: Grid resolution is a visualization choice and does not imply anatomical measurement precision.

validation: Reject unknown views and evidence classes.
Reject non-finite or out-of-range x and y values.
Reject negative or non-finite uncertainty values.
Require a non-empty source for every position.
Do not require z when it is unknown; preserve null rather than fabricate depth.
Keep source provenance and evidence class through projection, rendering, and export.
